content: The network monitoring configuration differentiates base network connectivity (Wi-Fi, local LAN, netbird management plane, mobile ping) from upper-layer connectivity; a passing base network check does not guarantee upper-layer direct HTTPS or upstream direct connectivity is healthy, with `direct_https = fail` and `network_resilience.layer = upstream-direct-degraded` serving as definitive indicators of upper-layer degradation even when base network is functional.
